notes: The hints along the bottom of the screen, and the prompt that appears when something is within reach, now name only the device actually in your hands. Pick up a controller and they become controller prompts; touch the keyboard and they turn back, before the next thing you walk up to.

They used to say both at once — a keyboard line and a controller line stacked together, and prompts that read "E · pad X" whichever one you were using. Half of that was always about a device you had put down.
title: It knows what you are holding
